summary_1line: Agni finds Indra hiding in a lotus stalk; the gods urge him to reclaim heaven from the powerful usurper Nahusha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Agni, entering the waters, discovers Indra in miniature form hiding within the fibers of a lotus stalk in a quiet reservoir.
The assembled gods, sages, and Gandharvas stand before Indra as he gradually expands back into his radiant divine form.
Indra, surrounded by the guardians of the world, assigns dominions to Yama, Varuna, and Kuvera as the gods prepare to confront Nahusha.
